decision_policy: ADMIT only for version-valid, covered, forward zero-yaw commands
LIMIT only after recomputing the scalar stopping envelope
STOP for stale/future data, identity mismatch, unavailable coverage, invalid limits, compute overrun, or infeasible current stopping state

scope_boundary.supported: Conservative one-dimensional forward corridor with explicit finite clearance and leases.
scope_boundary.disabled: Reverse motion, independent rotation, dynamic obstacle swept volumes, polygon footprint sweeps, ROS adapters, and watchdog process integration.
scope_boundary.reason: The technical specification requires separate geometry, coverage, and braking evidence before enabling those modes.

known_limitations: The current domain records and ROS adapters still require the coordinated revision-2 migration recorded in LIMIT-005.
The evaluator does not claim collision safety for angular motion or finite-size swept footprints.
